note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 3 October 1946 in two divisions. Nominations were received by Mr. Thomas Nelson, clerk and returning officer; Carrickfergus Rural and Templecorran were contested and both retiring members were returned. In Ballycorr, Eden, Islandmagee North, Islandmagee South and Raloo no nominations were made and the retiring members were declared re-elected; the other nine divisions had one nomination each (Larne Times, 26 September 1946, p. 2, which prints every division and marks the retiring members). No party labels are printed. Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
